citations.quote: Members and Candidates must not knowingly make any misrepresentations relating to investment analysis, recommendations, actions, or other professional activities.
Trust is the foundation of the investment profession. Investors must be able to rely on the statements and information provided to them

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Standard I.C prohibits Members/Candidates from knowingly making any misrepresentation in investment analysis, recommendations, actions, or other professional activities; the prohibition reaches plagiarism, performance-claim misstatement (overstated returns, cherry-picked composites), and material-omission misrepresentation where omitted context makes an otherwise-true statement misleading.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Standard I(C) Misrepresentation
